summary: Practise IT supplier pricing, SOW, SLA, and negotiation decisions. Explore the five-day course outline and assess fit for your role.
lede: IT contract negotiation helps IT procurement, contract administration, and service delivery professionals shape workable terms with technology suppliers. The training covers evaluating RFP responses, defining statement-of-work acceptance criteria, comparing pricing and total cost of ownership, setting measurable service levels, and preparing BATNA-based negotiation briefs. Exercises help participants document clause priorities, approval limits, supplier security evidence, and decisions for managing agreements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review, negotiate, approve, or administer contracts for software, infrastructure, and IT services.
modules: IT Contract Lifecycle and RFP Control
BATNA and ZOPA for IT Deals
IT Contract Risk and Clause Positions
IT Deal Governance and Approval Record
prerequisites: No formal contracting qualification is required. Familiarity with IT services, purchasing, or supplier proposals is useful. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel; no additional software installation or account is required.
